text.autoconfig.wtz-config.title: WynnToolZ Config
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountH: Highlights nearby mount powerups with name labels.
Changes the size of Mount Helper labels.
Dims or hides powerups whose tracked stat is already maxed on your current mount.
Set to 0 to always show maxed powerups as dimmed labels. Set above 0 to hide maxed powerups first, then show them dimmed after every nearby powerup has been maxed for this many seconds.
Opacity used for dimmed maxed powerup labels.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountS: Shows an overlay with stats for your current mount.
Opens and closes your inventory on powerup pickup to update mount item stats.
Reads mount stats from the mount item you are holding.
Keeps the mount stats overlay visible even when you are not mounted.
Controls how transparent the mount stats overlay background is.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountJ: Shows a movable jump-charge bar while charging a mount jump.
Keeps the jump-charge bar visible while mounted, even when the current jump charge is zero.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountE: Shows a movable custom mount energy bar using Wynncraft's tracked mount energy state.
Hides Wynncraft's vanilla mount energy actionbar while the custom energy bar is active.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountI: Shows extra mount information directly on mount items.
Adds the calculated mount potential to mount item overlays.
Shows stat bars on mount item overlays.
Requires the selected modifier key to show stat bars in inventory screens. None shows them at all times.
Shows mount stat bars on hotbar items even when inventory stat bars require a modifier key.
Displays the mount skin name above the item in the purchase window.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountS: Collects mount skins you purchase from NPCs and sends queued skin reports to the WTZ API when this option is enabled and an API token is linked.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountB: Collects mount breeding results locally and sends queued breed reports to the WTZ API when this option is enabled and an API token is linked.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.qualit: Master toggle for WynnToolZ quality-of-life helpers.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.qolRig: Right-clicks the Back item in Wynncraft menus when you right-click empty space or a slot without its own right-click action.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.qolHid: Hides the Wynncraft UI (NPC dialogue boxes, status messages, and other actionbar text) while chat is open.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.qolAct: Moves the Wynncraft UI (NPC dialogue boxes, status messages, and other actionbar text) above the chat input while chat is open.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.qolMac: Fixes a macOS issue where held movement keys can stop working after an inventory or menu closes.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.shoppi: Enables the in-game shopping list overlay.
Automatically opens the shopping list when you open the Trade Market from an NPC.
Changes the size of the shopping list overlay.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.bankFi: Enables WynnToolZ filters inside Wynntils bank and item search.
Adds mt:<type>, mc1:<color>, and mc2:<color> filters for mount type and color searches.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.mountC: Master toggle for the custom third-person mount camera and its sub-features.
Automatically switches to third-person when you mount up, and back to your previous view when you dismount.
While mounted in third-person, hold Left-Click to drag the camera around your mount without turning the player. Has no effect in first-person.
Allows limited mouse wheel zoom while using the mount camera.
Distance added to the mount camera zoom. Maximum is 15 blocks.
Field of view used by the mount camera. Set to Default to use your normal Minecraft FOV.
Moves the mount camera forward or backward.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.shoutT: Reads Wynncraft shout messages aloud using TikTok text-to-speech.
TikTok session id used for shout text-to-speech requests.
Sets the playback volume for shout text-to-speech.
Chooses the voice used for shout text-to-speech.
text.autoconfig.wtz-config.option.lookLi: Draws a line from your crosshair toward the block or entity you are looking at.
Maximum distance the look line can reach.
Color and opacity of the look line.
